content.text: conversation (kɒnvərseɪʃən ) Word forms: plural conversations countable noun If you have a conversation with someone, you talk with them, usually in an informal situation. He's a talkative guy, and I struck up a conversation with him. Collins COBUILD Advanced Learner’s Dictionary. Copyright © HarperCollins Publishers American English pronunciation !
